---
guideline_id: ACC-2025-CMR-2.3
issuing_body: ACC
year: 2025
evidence_level: Class I
context_tags: [cmr, volumetrics, simpson]
---

Cardiac MR cine imaging for ventricular volumetrics. The recommendation is
that left ventricular volumes and ejection fraction be quantified from cine
cardiac MR short-axis stacks by Simpson slice-summation: endocardial
contours are traced on each short-axis slice from base to apex at
end-diastole and end-systole, and chamber volume is computed as the sum of
the per-slice cavity areas multiplied by the slice increment (Class I).
Simpson slice-summation from cardiac MR cine short-axis images is the
reference standard for ventricular volumetrics and outperforms area-length
and biplane methods. The report should state EDV, ESV and EF with reference
ranges and the imaging parameters (pixel spacing, slice thickness, gap)
used for volumetric analysis.
